Anya Patel: quick Q — am I eligible for Redwood's childcare subsidy while I'm on 12 weeks parental leave? planning to start leave Apr 12. does the subsidy continue during unpaid weeks? :thinking_face:

Samir Khan: congrats! :tada: short answer: yes, in most cases. the subsidy is tied to active benefits enrollment, not to payroll status, but there are rules. can you DM me your start/end dates so i can check payroll windows?

Anya Patel: thanks — sending DM. i'm trying to figure out if i need to file anything special before leave so the payments keep flowing.

People Ops (bot): Reminder: subsidies and benefit top-ups require a benefits enrollment snapshot 30 days before leave start. See: https://intra.redwood.com/benefits/childcare-subsidy (internal link)

Micah Reed: fyi — when samir pulled this for me last year we had to submit the "Leave Benefits Continuation" form + payroll code. payroll uses code PL-CHILD for the subsidy top-up.

Samir Khan: right — please fill out the Leave Benefits Continuation form and attach the approval email. workflow: 1) fill form 2) send to benefits@redwood.com 3) cc payroll@redwood.com if you want auto top-up. deadline ideally 14 days before leave.

Jordan Lee: also confirm whether you'll be on full unpaid leave or partial paid (govt/top-up combo) — that affects gross income reporting for the subsidy.

Anya Patel: i'm doing full 12 weeks unpaid after using 4 weeks of company-paid leave. is that problematic?

Samir Khan: that's fine. we just need to confirm benefit enrollment doesn't lapse. i'll flag your case with benefits to keep the subsidy active. if any gap in enrollment appears we have a manual override but it'll be slower.

Micah Reed: pro tip — if you want daycare invoices auto-paid, set up the vendor as a recurring payment in the portal and tag it "childcare-subsidy" so payroll matches it automatically. helped me avoid re-uploads.

Anya Patel: what's the paperwork name exactly? i'm hunting through the docs and there are a few similar PDFs.

Samir Khan: use the file named "Leave_Benefits_Continuation_2025.pdf" in the benefits folder. i'll drop it here.

Samir Khan: [uploaded file] Leave_Benefits_Continuation_2025.pdf

People Ops (bot): Action required: submit completed Leave_Benefits_Continuation_2025.pdf to benefits@redwood.com by 1762997600 to avoid processing delays.

Anya Patel: thanks — will do today. once it's sent do i get a confirmation receipt?

Samir Khan: yes — benefits will reply with a confirmation email within 48 business hours. if you don't see it ping me and i'll escalate.

Jordan Lee: FYI team — for parental leave coverage planning: Anya pls add notes in the team-runbook with key handoffs (oncall, weekly syncs). we can book a 30-min triage before Apr 1.

Anya Patel: noted — scheduling the handoff meeting now. thanks everyone! :heart:
